title: PcaSettings
description: Settings for the PCA sync task.

begin.description:
Inclusive index of the first eigencomponent to keep. Must satisfy:
- begin >= 0
- begin < end

end.description:
Exclusive index of the last eigencomponent to keep. Must satisfy:
- end > begin
- end <= number of input features

window_size.description: Spatial neighborhood width for Local PCA (odd and positive). Zero selects whole-frame PCA. The temporal depth comes from the input feature dimension.
